display_title: Maybe We'll Know If We Do XX?
description:
Jae, leader of the group Runners High, and rapper Beom-Jun boast chemistry that's recognized not only within the group but also among fans. However, Beom-Jun realized he liked Jae more than just as a friend, and he ended up turning that feeling into a solo song. Beom-Jun was curious about Jae's reaction to his self-composed song, but he didn't really have any particular expectations. But then... when Beom-Jun asks about his feelings, Jae suddenly drops a bombshell.

 *“Wouldn't you know if you did XX?”* 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: The second story in Mago Creative's Idol Danpyeonseon (아이돌 단편선) Collection.*
